profile_text.body:
IBM is a publicly traded technology company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, New York, with annual revenue of 67.535 billion dollars. The company describes IBM OpenPages as a scalable, AI-powered unified GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) platform available on any cloud or on-premises. OpenPages offers modular components tailored to specific risk and compliance domains, with an interactive workspace called the GRC Canvas for modeling processes, risks, and controls using live data. The company embeds AI to automate classification, issue creation, and risk management activities, reducing manual effort and accelerating compliance work.

IBM's AI governance products include IBM OpenPages with Watson, which integrates Watson AI for automated documentation and regulatory mapping, and IBM watsonx.governance, a dedicated AI lifecycle governance tool for model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation that supports EU AI Act compliance. The broader IBM watsonx platform provides enterprise AI capabilities with model-agnostic governance through agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection. IBM has positioned OpenPages for autonomous AI-driven operations, offering an MCP Server that securely enables AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects. The platform supports flexible, API-based integration with IBM, third-party, or custom AI models to avoid vendor lock-in. IDC recognized IBM as a leader in AI-enabled financial governance, risk, and compliance, and Citi has partnered with IBM to automate internal audit processes using AI and machine learning. IBM faces 342 lawsuits with New York law exposure.
